launches.title: Veeza AI — AI tourist visa agent for people with weak passports
launches.tagline: Pick your destination. We'll handle everything else.
launches.body:
**TL;DR** [Veeza AI](https://veeza.ai) helps people with weak passports get tourist visas. Upload your passport, and our computer-use agents verify your documents, fill in all the forms and book your visa appointment.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pGgKG-L-VBU>

**The problem**

Hey, I'm Aly. I'm Canadian-Egyptian, and I've traveled on a strong passport and a weak one. With a strong one, you book a flight. With a weak one, you spend hours filling out forms (the UK's is 68 steps long), collect a stack of documents, then fight for an appointment like Taylor Swift tickets. And just like with Taylor Swift tickets, scalpers get there first. Their bots grab the slots and resell them for as much as $1,000.

My friends and I have missed weddings, engagements and conferences because of this. I get that countries need to vet who comes in. It just shouldn't be this hard.

**How Veeza AI works**

1. Pick your destination from 33 countries, including the US, the UK, Canada and Schengen countries.
2. Upload your passport and documents. Our AI verifies them, flags anything missing, fills in all the forms and books your visa appointment.
3. A human reviews everything to make sure it's done right.

Behind the scenes, our computer-use agents work through the government portals for you.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=122484&key=user_uploads/578651/140a58f6-93a5-4631-aaff-51ce99d2417f)

Since joining YC, we've grown from 1,000 to 7,000+ users. People are recommending us to their families and coming back for their next visa. A woman applied through Veeza AI, then her mom did, then her grandmother. One traveler has had four visas approved through us since June.

About 5 billion people have weak passports. We estimate the Global South files 200 million tourist visa applications a year. We're starting with MENA, then the entire Global South. And as personal AI agents start planning and booking people's trips, Veeza AI will be where they turn for visas.

**How you can help**

Know a travel agency or company whose customers need tourist visas? I'd love an intro for B2B2C partnerships.

You can reach us at [**founders@veeza.ai**](mailto:founders@veeza.ai).

Aly
